chapter: Kid Ory, Hampton, Ellington and Ben Webster
title: Playing with Kid Ory and bassists who could not read
summary: Mingus took any job with music to read; Ory could hardly sight-read bass.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: One thing I never asked you about, you played with Kid Orey. What was that like, both in terms of the kind of person he was --
I was open. I was learning, and I wanted to play with anybody that had music to read, because everybody's music was experience.
I was studying classical bass, and classical bass (inaudible). He writes right now with Eddie Gomez.
He was a very well trained bass player, but (inaudible).
Yeah, that's interesting. Was Orey like some of the New Orleans --
He can read a little bit.
Berez reads better than he does.
